title: Theory that directed energy forces transdimensional objects into physical form

tellings.quote: by hitting it with like something like directed energy, you're forcing it to take form and become bound to this dimension.

plain: Jordan Jose's idea is that some UFOs come from another dimension, and that hitting one with directed energy, a focused beam of energy like a weapon, is "forcing it to take form and become bound to this dimension." Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, puts this to Michels as his own theory of how such objects could be brought down and caught.
